preregistered: 2026-10-20, committed before the runner exists and before any statistic below that is not listed under already_seen was computed
framing: DISCLOSED POST-HOC. The hypothesis came from looking at these two messages (phase5-trigram-repeat-v1, exploratory section) and every statistic listed under already_seen is known. This experiment measures how strong that observation is under a fixed statistic, null and multiplicity correction. It is not an independent confirmation, and no result here should be described as one.

already_seen.FKQLZ: 107 letters (first group excluded); no J; IC 0.0326; 14 of 20,000 Enigma-null draws had a lower IC (phase5-trigram-repeat-v1); no repeated quadgram with or without the first group.
already_seen.XFEDT: 97 letters; no J; IC 0.0329; 76 of 20,000 draws lower; no repeated quadgram.
already_seen.grey_texts: Ostwald's printed lengths, IC values and J column for all ten controls; they have no J by his classification. Their IC ranges from 2.13% to 4.93%: CSBTR 3.33, FTBCO 3.79, SSRAC 2.13, BCSSF 3.39, AOKAX 4.85, XDPAK 4.78, KHZMY 3.20, AWMRI 3.35, YDFZS 2.93, SDPLM 4.93 (first group included).
already_seen.not_seen: The joint statistic's value for any text, any quadgram count for the grey texts, and every p-value against the uniform 25-letter null.

hypothesis: FKQLZ and XFEDT carry the letter signature of the J-less grey system (no J and a letter distribution flatter than Enigma output) to a degree Enigma I output of Army plaintext produces with probability below 0.001 per message.
refuted_by: Either target's joint p-value at or above 0.001 under the Enigma null, with the calibration holding.
target_text: corpus.json ciphertext, first group excluded (the Enigma discriminant convention the earlier tests use).

primary.name: joint_noj_lowic
primary.definition: Upper-bound-style tail probability under a null: (1 + #draws with J-count <= observed J-count AND index_of_coincidence <= observed) / (1 + draws). Uncertain characters ('?') are excluded from both counts. index_of_coincidence is phase5.index_of_coincidence.

secondary.name: quadgram_repeats
secondary.definition: Sum over distinct quadgrams of (n - 1) for n >= 2, windows containing '?' skipped; upper tail (1 + #draws >= observed) / (1 + draws).

secondary.name: quadgram_repeats_with_first_group
secondary.definition: The same on the text with its first group prepended, against a null of length + 5. Reported for the targets only.

secondary.name: p_ic_lower_uniform25
secondary.definition: Lower-tail IC p against uniformly random text over the 25 letters without J, same length and masked positions: is the text flatter than random, not only flatter than Enigma?

enigma.description: As phase5-trigram-repeat-v1: a uniformly random window of the 858-letter pool of data/historical/keyed-messages.json raw plaintexts ('-' removed) enciphered by enigma.EnigmaI (reflector B) under an independent uniformly random key (wheel order from I-V, rings, start, ten plugs). Positions uncertain in the scored text are masked to '?'.

uniform25.description: Each letter independently uniform over A-Z without J; same length and masked positions.

enigma_calibration.description: The 13 authentic Enigma ciphertexts of data/historical/keyed-messages.json ('-' as uncertain), each against its own length-matched Enigma null, 20000 draws, seed 20261026.
enigma_calibration.requirement: none of the 13 has joint_noj_lowic below the threshold
enigma_calibration.known_weakness: Most are short, and several contain J, which makes their joint p large by construction. This calibration can only catch a grossly miscalibrated null.

grey_positive.description: The ten grey texts without Enigma-type indicators, data/phase5/grey-texts-ostwald-2023.json, scored on their full text (first group included; no discriminant convention for hand ciphers) against length-matched Enigma nulls (draws_controls, seed_controls, in file order).
grey_positive.expectation: J-absence is true of all ten by construction, so p_noj is not evidence for them. The control shows what the statistic does on the J-less system. Expected: the four at least 80 letters long with IC below 3.6% (CSBTR, BCSSF, AWMRI, YDFZS) have joint p below the threshold; the four 'rough' or higher-IC texts (FTBCO, AOKAX, XDPAK, SDPLM) do not. The three short ones (SSRAC 38, KHZMY 29, SDPLM 49) are reported without expectation, except SDPLM as above.
grey_positive.expectation_failure_means: A flat long grey text not flagged, or a rough one flagged, means the joint statistic does not separate the grey system's flat texts from Enigma as intended, and the target result is reported as uninterpretable.

decision.threshold_rationale: 0.01 Bonferroni-corrected over the ten looks that found this lead: five Batch C messages times two IC tails. Stricter than v1's 0.002 because the targets were chosen after looking.
decision.rule: A target is flagged 'J-less and flatter than Enigma' when joint_noj_lowic < threshold, provided the Enigma calibration holds and the grey positive control meets its expectation. Otherwise no target is flagged and the reason is recorded.
decision.prediction: Both FKQLZ and XFEDT are flagged (expected from the already-seen values; disclosed).
decision.what_it_does_not_decide: It does not identify the cipher, does not show the targets belong to the same system as the grey texts (only that they share its J-less, flat signature), and is not independent of the data that suggested it.
decision.implication_to_record: If either target is flagged: phase 1 sweeps used FKQLZ and XFEDT as companion messages to confirm BYQMZ candidates under a shared daily key. A non-Enigma companion would reject a true BYQMZ key, so the companion-confirmation step of those sweeps must be re-examined (their top-score-versus-noise-maximum checks do not depend on companions).
